baseline_defect.observed: A fresh dependency installation selected sphinxcontrib 2.x extensions that require Sphinx 5 or newer, while the repository pins Sphinx 4.5.0.
baseline_defect.effect: Both language builds stopped before reading source documents.
baseline_defect.resolution: Pinned Sphinx 4.5-compatible sphinxcontrib extension releases in docs/requirements.txt.

limitations: This repository contains documentation and no firmware or runtime application to compile.
PDF, EPUB and HTML ZIP are not requested by .readthedocs.yaml and were not validated.
External-link availability and third-party content correctness were not tested.
No device flashing or hardware-in-the-loop validation applies to this repository.
